title: 第21章 被师尊强吻了第22章 道心受损
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 感受到突然出现的炙热气息，纵然是性格清冷的慕容雪，也不禁露出了惊骇之色。
“师尊，接下来我会用这异火帮你压制寒毒。
但是过程可能会有些痛苦，你一定要忍住，实在忍不住就跟我说哈！”
徐墨面色凝重的说道。
慕容清轻抿樱唇，点了点头。
闻言，徐墨不再磨叽，小心地控制阴阳混沌炎进入其体内，帮她压制寒毒。
有了阴阳混沌炎的加入，至阳之气瞬间被加强了十数倍不止，仅仅片刻，便顺利将寒毒压制。
徐墨见状，面色一喜，然后没等他高兴多久，他突然发现了一丝不对。
被阴阳混沌炎加持的至阳之气，在压制寒毒的过程中，竟与慕容雪体内的至阴之气产生了融合。
随后竟化为了一缕阴阳二气，进入了慕容雪体内深处。
瞬间，慕容雪就俏脸通红，娇躯滚烫，就连抱着她的徐墨都感觉到了这股热量。
“好热…我好热啊！”
慕容雪的清澈的星眸逐渐开始迷离，娇躯不受控制地在徐墨怀中扭动。
“卧槽！
这什么情况！”
徐墨看到慕容雪的反应后，直接惊呼出声。
他是真没想到，得到加持的至阳之气，会与慕容雪体内的至阴之气融合，从而变成传闻中的阴阳二气！
虽然阴阳二气虽然好处多多，但是也有一个严重的弊端，那就是能激发人内心最深处的欲火，从而产生最原始的冲动。
若是再严重点，甚至会沦为被**支配的奴隶。
显然，慕容雪现在就被阴阳二气影响了，已然没了理智。
“师尊，你一定要忍住啊！
我很快就好了，你要坚持！”
徐墨声音颤抖的说道。
其实解决阴阳二气的方法有很多，但是其中最快最有效的方法却只有一个。
那就是双修！
可是在他怀里的，可不是他的侍女柳如烟，也不是被他拿捏把柄的白昕儿。
而是修为境界达到准帝的师尊慕容雪啊。
徐墨若是敢趁其神志不清，与其双修，那他敢肯定，待慕容雪事后清醒过来，必会一剑斩了他。
所以他不能以自己的性命为赌注，享受一时之快。
就这样，徐墨一边安慰自己，忍受着在怀中乱动的娇躯，一边替她压制寒毒。
“徐墨，为师的身体突然好痒啊。
好像有蚂蚁在我身上爬，这到底是怎么一回事！”
慕容雪用她清冷的声音，说出了最让徐墨激动的话，这声音如同通恶魔的低语般，不断诱惑着徐墨。
“师尊，我知道你难受，其实我也难受。
但是你一定要忍住，我马上就能彻底压制了。”
徐墨显然也很难受，就连说话都有些磕巴。
content_en:
Feeling the sudden hot aura, even Murong Xue, who had a cold personality, couldn't help showing a look of horror.
"Master, next I will use this strange fire to help you suppress the cold poison.
But the process may be a little painful, so you must endure it. If you can’t help it, just tell me! "
Xu Mo said with a solemn expression.
"Okay!"
Murong Qing pursed her lips and nodded.
Hearing this, Xu Mo stopped fussing and carefully controlled the yin and yang chaos flames to enter her body to help her suppress the cold poison.
With the addition of the Yin-Yang Chaos Flame, the Yang Qi was instantly strengthened more than ten times, and in just a moment, the cold poison was successfully suppressed.
When Xu Mo saw this, he looked happy, and before he could be happy for long, he suddenly noticed something was wrong.
The Yang Qi blessed by the Yin and Yang Chaos Flame actually merged with the Yin Qi in Murong Xue's body during the process of suppressing the cold poison.
Then it turned into a wisp of yin and yang energy and entered the depths of Murong Xue's body.
In an instant, Murong Xue's pretty face turned red, her body was hot, and even Xu Mo, who was holding her, felt the heat.
"It's so hot...I'm so hot!"
Murong Xue's clear starry eyes gradually began to blur, and her delicate body twisted uncontrollably in Xu Mo's arms.
“Fuck!
What's going on! "
Xu Mo exclaimed in surprise after seeing Murong Xue's reaction.
He really didn't expect that the blessed Yang Qi would merge with the Yin Qi in Murong Xue's body, thus becoming the rumored two qi of Yin and Yang!
Although the two qi of yin and yang have many benefits, they also have a serious disadvantage, that is, they can stimulate the deepest desires in people's hearts, thus producing the most primitive impulses.
If it is more serious, he may even become a slave controlled by his mother.
Obviously, Murong Xue was now affected by the Yin and Yang Qi and had lost her mind.
"Master, you must hold back!
I'll be fine soon, just hold on! "
Xu Mo said with a trembling voice.
In fact, there are many ways to solve the problem of Yin and Yang, but there is only one fastest and most effective method.
That’s dual cultivation!
But the person in his arms was not his maid Liu Ruyan, nor was it Bai Xin'er who was being manipulated by him.
It's Master Murong Xue, whose cultivation has reached the level of quasi-emperor.
If Xu Mo dared to practice dual cultivation with him while he was unconscious, then he was sure that when Murong Xue woke up afterwards, he would kill him with one sword.
Therefore, he cannot risk his life to enjoy the pleasure of the moment.
In this way, Xu Mo comforted himself and endured the movement of her delicate body in his arms, while suppressing the cold poison for her.
"Xu Mo, my teacher's body suddenly feels so itchy.
It seems like there are ants crawling on me, what is going on! "
Murong Xue used her cold voice to say the words that excited Xu Mo the most. This voice was like a devil's whisper, constantly tempting Xu Mo.
"Master, I know you feel uncomfortable, and actually I feel uncomfortable too.
But you must hold back, I will completely suppress you soon. "
Xu Mo was obviously feeling very uncomfortable, and he even stuttered a bit when he spoke.
